title: Entity overview
responsibility: Introduces each page's purpose, then shows visual evidence before measurements; contract and usage have dedicated tabs.

inputs.name: EntityOverview.entity
inputs.description: The entity name, category, registered purpose and removal state at the viewed revision.

inputs.name: EntityOverview.measure
inputs.description: Required prepared measurements passed to the summary.

inputs.name: EntityOverview.children
inputs.description: Required content snippet for evidence appropriate to this entity.

outputs.name: EntityOverview
outputs.description: Pages begin with their registered purpose when available. Visual evidence follows, then one Performance profile with normal stack spacing between content blocks. Other entities retain measurement-first evidence. Contract and usage appear in their own tabs.
